title: heptapleurum exaltatum
intro: Heptapleurum exaltatum, commonly known as Kava, is a plant species belonging to the family Araliaceae. Kava has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress levels, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of restlessness and irritability. The therapeutic actions of Kava are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be triggered by the bioactive constituents such as flavokawain B, desmethoxyyangonin, and yangonin. These bioactive compounds have been shown to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, producing a calming effect and contributing to the plant's medicinal properties.
